name: Westfield Auto Parts
old_description: Westfield Auto Parts is a locally-owned and operated automotive parts store that has been serving the Westfield area since 1953.
about:
Westfield Auto Parts has operated as a locally owned automotive parts store in Westfield, Massachusetts since 1953. The business was founded as a neighborhood supplier and has remained under local ownership for over seven decades, serving the Pioneer Valley region from its location at 8 Birge Avenue.

The company stocks and sells original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and aftermarket parts for a wide range of vehicles, including engine, transmission, brake, suspension, cooling, fuel, and exhaust components. In addition to counter and online sales, Westfield Auto Parts runs a courier service that delivers parts free of charge to repair shops and customers in Westfield and surrounding communities such as Granville, Blandford, Huntington, Russell, Southampton, Westhampton, Chester, and Otis. The store also offers custom paint services and operates a machine shop for component repair and fabrication, though specific equipment details are not published.

Customers include professional repair technicians, fleet operators, and do-it-yourself vehicle owners. The business supports both walk-in traffic and e-commerce orders with in-store pickup, online package tracking, and a 30-day return policy. Its courier service is tailored to commercial accounts that need same-day parts replenishment without leaving the shop.

Westfield Auto Parts emphasizes the combination of digital convenience and in-person expertise, promoting manufacturer coupons and rebates, warranty-backed OEM parts, and a specialist staff that helps locate hard-to-find items. The company positions itself as a single source for parts, paint, and machining services for the local automotive market.
